headline: Samsone reports open 99M–356M audio models with Android CPU inference results
summary: A paper accepted at Interspeech 2026 describes three open small audio language models with 99M, 134M and 356M parameters, and an Android application for on-device inference. On the MMAU benchmark, the authors report that the 99M and 134M variants exceed the 167M Mellow model on the average scores shown; they also report 39–125 generated tokens per second on a Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra CPU using 15 audio-query pairs. Training code, checkpoints, mobile weights and Android application code are listed in the project repository. These are author-reported results; this review did not run the app or independently reproduce the benchmark or timing.
